;;;4040   	if (au > 128) au = 128;

;;;2165   static
;;;2166   FRESULT find_volume (	/* FR_OK(0): successful, !=0: any error occurred */

;;;2167   	FATFS** rfs,		/* Pointer to pointer to the found file system object */

00001a  200b              MOVS     r0,#0xb

;;;2187   	if (!fs) return FR_NOT_ENABLED;		/* Is the file system object available? */
;;;2188   
;;;2189   	ENTER_FF(fs);						/* Lock the volume */
;;;2190   	*rfs = fs;							/* Return pointer to the file system object */
;;;2191   
;;;2192   	if (fs->fs_type) {					/* If the volume has been mounted */
;;;2193   		stat = disk_status(fs->drv);
;;;2194   		if (!(stat & STA_NOINIT)) {		/* and the physical drive is kept initialized */
;;;2195   			if (!_FS_READONLY && wmode && (stat & STA_PROTECT))	/* Check write protection if needed */
;;;2196   				return FR_WRITE_PROTECTED;
;;;2197   			return FR_OK;				/* The file system object is valid */
;;;2198   		}
;;;2199   	}
;;;2200

;;;2202   	/* Following code attempts to mount the volume. (analyze BPB and initialize the fs object) */
